name: constitution-4-0-eight-principles
notes: The owner HADES brief version 4.0 becomes the constitution of record at 00_START_HERE/CONSTITUTION.md. Its eight principles outrank every executive law and may be amended only by a manual charter revision with the owners explicit approval, a version record and a security audit; no automated cycle may change them. Precedence ladder: the eight principles, then 00_START_HERE/PROJECT_CHARTER.md, then the executive law register L-01..L-10, then ROADMAP.md and code.
